title: Vinest Makeup — Abuja Bridal Makeup Artist
description: Timeless soft glam for brides in Abuja and beyond. Bridal, casual glam and makeup classes. Founder of Vinest Cosmetics.

hero.headlineHtml: Timeless soft glam for your forever photos.
hero.text: Bridal, trad and nikkah glam that looks like you on your best day, in person and in every photo. Based in Wuse 2, Abuja, and available to travel.

main.alt: Traditional bride with coral beads in soft glam by Vinest Makeup

items.title: Bridal
items.text: White wedding, trad and nikkah looks with a trial, built to last through every outfit change.

items.title: Trad & ceremonies
items.text: Coral beads, gele and headpieces: glam that holds its own next to the culture.

items.title: Casual glam
items.text: Birthdays, shoots, dinners and events, done in soft, polished Vinest style.

items.title: Vinest Cosmetics
items.text: The products behind the look, available to shop on the live site.

feature.title: Learn soft glam
feature.sub: classes for beginners and working artists
feature.text: Learn the techniques behind the Vinest look: skin prep, soft sculpting, lashes and bridal longevity. Class dates and fees go here, with online registration and payment.
feature.ctaMsg: On the live site students register and pay online with Paystack, and get an automatic confirmation.

booking.title: Check if your date is free
booking.text: Bridal dates book out fast. Send your details and we'll confirm availability and send a quote.
terms: A deposit secures your date. Dates aren't held without it.
Travel outside Abuja is quoted per booking.
booking.termsNote: Deposit and travel terms are samples. The live site would use Vinest's own policy.

footer.blurb: Timeless soft glam beauty. Abuja bridal makeup artist and educator, founder of Vinest Cosmetics.
